item: A session that writes under the gate asks for its pooled connection first at every site the raw-connection scan could not see, the scan now reads sessions, and the orphan prune holds the gate per chunk
summary: The read of the final head (M2): with write_lock(): session.get/execute/commit on a session that holds no connection (it committed, rolled back, or was never used) checked the pooled connection out UNDER the gate, the order the first fix removed from the hooks and the raw sites; the scan looked for engine.connect and session.connection and could not see it (a pool of one: the site held the gate and timed out on the pool). connection_first(session) now runs before the gate at 21 call lines in 20 functions (bulk_build open/close, counter_deferral open/close, corpus_epoch bump inside its try so a pool timeout stays a missed bump, keyword_fold.fold_page, source_topics on a fresh session after its rollback and on a shared one, analytics/store: backfill, both reconcile sweeps, source counters, article language, the two bulk keyword writers and the orphan prune; api/ingestion newsletter undo, catalog discover and wikidata_apply, fts.optimize_after_bulk, each chunk turn of email.delete_imported_newsletters). prune_orphan_keywords held the gate across all of a slice's delete chunks and each commit gave the connection back, so every chunk after the first took the pool under the gate: it holds the gate per chunk and each chunk asks again, under the gate, which of its keywords gained a mention since (those stay, with their tags). tests/test_gate_connection_order.py now reads session use under the gate (a name taken for a session, a connection given back by a commit, rollback or close in between, the next loop turn) with 14 more snippets; tests/test_gate_connection_order_sessions.py probes 14 sites on fresh sessions (EVERY first ask of the gate has a connection out) and the prune in both orders. 21 mutants (each added line removed) and five hand mutants killed. Not seen by the scan: a checkout made deeper in a call under the gate (stream_backup._drain_wal, F10, RC2's file, is an open item).
